notes.title: Hard Bullet Demo is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/7c944e672ee9e192b3c999fc3635ae4121db2a15.png
We've been working hard on this new VR game Hard Bullet and now want to gather your feedback.

Shoot, kick, destroy, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Visit the Store Page or Steam Festival to get a Demo and start a mess!

Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png
We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

Destructions and Physics
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png
Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.


Current Demo Limitations
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png

 Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  
 No tutorial. Working on it.
 Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
 Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
 Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
 Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.
 Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
 Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
 Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
 Grenades and explosions are turned off.



Join our Discord

Talk directly to the devs, share your opinion and ideas with us!
Joining Discord will help you to stay on Beta Test after the Festival.

Probably we'll turn the Hard Bullet Demo off and will release an updated version after a while.
To stay on the latest Demo build you can join the Beta Test through our Discord Server.

Wishlist and Follow us on Steam!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif
Add Hard Bullet Steam Page to your wishlist so you'll be ready when it comes.

Steam Forums Feedback

Visit Hard Bullet Steam Discussion Forums and share your feedback there with us!

notes.title: Nevrosa: Primal Ritual is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/11a83c023495bbcc46d93c5bd6ccfaec512b6b1d.jpg
Hello friends, we are happy to announce our biggest game so far — action adventure in open Misty World is launched on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070410/Nevrosa_Primal_Ritual/

 World Exploration. Travel across vast lands covered with layers of mist, meet unbelievable plant-animal hybrids, that have been ruling this place for centuries, discover gorgeous ruins of vanished civilization and watch breathtaking scenes around you.

 Story full of Mysteries. Story driven adventure as fearless scientist William Conway who finds an unexpected ally in a face of mystic Cursed Cube which possesses great powers.

 Dangerous Adventure. Main resource to control everything — your own blood. Save precious drops for upgrades or load them as ammo into your faithful Vampire Gun.

 Realistic Graphics. Building Primal Ritual exclusively for VR, we worked carefully to improve unique Nevrosa style in all the things around you. Classic horror movies and books like The Mist, The Thing, Hellraiser and even Avatar inspired the design of creatures and atmosphere.

 Voice acting and Soundtrack. New unforgettable themes from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov will create a true cinematographic experience. Music reacts according to the game situation. Find out more good music tracks on the records in the Camp to get into the right mood.

We want to thank everyone of you who liked our games and what we do in VR. Only because of our great community it is possible to produce new VR content and take you to new worlds. 

See you in the Misty World.
GexagonVR Team.

notes.title: Story Mode Delayed
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/02f6cb2badb604f208d304d0104f318b7e2a6e5e.jpg

Hello, fellow Cyberbikers!

The grid brings some news for you and today they are not as good as we hoped.

 We decided to delay the Story mode once again. 
Sorry about that, we want to bring you polished and interesting game in the cyberpunk world we are working on. Right now we can't say the date Qbike comes out of Early Access, not this summer anyway.

Thank for staying with us, supporting and buying our games 

So what to expect:

 Cyberpunk story based on cryptocurrency.
 Challenging tasks on multiple arenas with bots and unexpected events.
 Boss fights on arenas.
 New skills and abilities.
 Procedurally generated "tube" races as a separate Co-Op mode.


Easy Riders Thursday Club
Join our weekly Thursday events to have a chance to talk to developers and spend some fun time together.

You can check the schedule on  VRLFG website

notes.title: Updates and PC/Mac release
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/6a8e21c82034d071e37735bd90ae9931144cf772.jpg

Hi, this week we launched our first non-VR game on Steam — Qbike: Crypto Motorcycles:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/713610/Qbike_Crypto_Motorcycles/

For all VR users, this brings more players online and ability to get yourself a standalone version through PC vs VR Bundle with an awesome 20% discount!

You can play on your Windows, MacOS X and Linux devices. Qbike is really well optimised so even low-end machines will run it.

Updates:

Reworked collision scenarios were both bikers got destroyed in duels. Now bikes will hit with some force but survive you or not will depend only on you.
Smasher hitbox increased. It's much easier now to destroy the opponent by falling on him.
French Language added.
Updated some translations.

notes.title: Team Deathmatch and other Updates
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/3c620856401b690de5207b683fe0c7b9cc4401ac.jpg
New Deathmatch mode
Added Team Deathmatch for those who like to play together as a team.
You can start 2v2 games in Red or Green team. Both Long and Short trail mods are supported.

Some UI images are not finished yet, but everything in the game works fine.

Multilanguage Update
With great community help, we made translations to 8 world languages, here they are:

 Chinese 
 Czech by Petr Valis r/u/Twisp56
 Dutch
 Portu-Brazil 
 Russian 
 German 
 Korean by Bumchul Kim r/u/MinimalResults
 Spanish

We believe there could be some bugs/misspelling so if you have noticed a bug or bad translation — leave your feedback here to help make it better.

We still need help with French, Italian, and Japanese translations, so if you can help us — feel free to contact.

Big Sound Update
We added tens of new SFX and reworked those we already had. 

This sound work just started, so expect minor sound updates during the development without special announcements.

Minor Updates:

Reworked Main Menu logic so it's whole new thing inside for us and very much the same for you.
Updated Demo Languages.
Prepaired QbikeVR for cross-platform with PC, Mac, Linux.


Join us to improve Qbike:
Official Qbike Discord Channel
Steam Discussions

GexagonVR Team

New Motion Controlls for steering

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/5793c2b547e3e18cce34d8f6e4f055eea5659b42.jpg

notes.title: New Motion Controlls
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/88cac684c519f518534166cca0ead15b272471a7.jpg

We continue to work on new controll setups on the way to simulate real quantum-powered cyberpunk motorcycle riding experience.

In this update we trying to implement some hand steering controlls, without making it too hard or annoying.

When you switch to Controllers in the Settings menu your bike becomes affected by your Motion Controllers position.

The lower one controller is accordingly to the other one — the stronger turn you will make.

You can hold your hands in the air (quiet hard to hold them for the long time) or just place them on your knees and slightly move up or down  when you need.

notes.title: Hours before EA
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/82799859124c0c379e6994c1bea437eeed6caa7a.jpg
Hi, we want to introduce to you the new core features of the Qbike Cyberpunk Motorcycles.

During the Match (deathmatch it is for now) players will be able to earn Performance Points and get to the Global Leaderboards.

Leaderboards and Performance Points

While we are testing and balancing new skills, you can start practicing in earning points! When the skill set is finished, Performance Points will help you to unlock and upgrade new player abilities.

Your points amount, total wins and kills scores will be added to world wide Qbike Leaderboards. 
We plan to upgrade and add more interesting statistics during the development. 

Score Multiplicator

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/599c41004e001e79453e4cae0543d98caba31c62.jpg
You can raise your PP by performing various tricks and challenges during the race.

Every time you earn 100 PP you receive 1 bar to your total power multiplicator.

Every level will multiply your race score until you die. To reach next Multiplicator level you'll need to complete challenges again, but you'll receive more points accordingly to the current Multiplicator level.

Current Challenges Available

We are going to update and expand this list during EA.

The following Challenges add one Multiplicator bar:

Destroying player's bike gives you 200 points
Ride under Ark — Sneak under Barrier Arch to get 50 points
Maneuver —  gives 100 points when fast-killing opponent with your barrier
Air Time — starts after one second is spent in the air
Drift Time — you can achieve this by making a fast turn before the jump
Close Call — gives 50 points every moment while riding close to the opponent


The following Challenges give you bonus scores in the end and during the match:

Kills in a row give you 50 on the second, 100 on the third, 150 on the 4th and so on
Air Kill gives you 100 bonus points
First place — 100 points
Win without using Abilities — 100 points
Win the match — 100 points
Never die during the race  — 100 points


The nearest Updates:
Full Roadmap Here

Different Controls setups
We are working on new controllers scheme where you can control the bike with your own hands like IRL. Looking into "steering with your body" option.

Dedicated Servers. 
In fact, the only thing which separates us from this goal is our budget. Hope it improves soon!

Carrier/Decent Single Player mode. 
We want to tell you Qbike story so you can get the full vision of this future world where the New Gold Rush transforms crypto miners into cyberpunk racers.

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/7ff98cb64f85f77845f39e1977f281c512c285b5.jpg

Beta keys called back before Early Access

We called back all the Qbike Beta test keys. Thank you for your interest. Hope we've  brought you some fun and memorable moments during these weeks.
Coming to Early Access is a big thing for us and we still need your help in developing Qbike. Leave your feedback in our Steam Groups so we can make this game better!

Demo Updates

Qbike demo will be updated up to the current EA version with some limitations.
Deathmatch multiplayer will be removed. All PvP and Co-Op modes now move to Early Access.

That doesn't mean Demo users will be left on the edge of XXII's century crypto gold rush. You'll need all your experience to get to World Leaderboards by accomplishing Daily Skill Challenges!

You can find more details about Challenges in this Announcement

notes.title: Infinite Trail mode
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/fb66c074c7cdaf089f784d6608a723cf46a75254.jpg

Hi, we finished working on Infinite Trail mode.

When you choose this play mode your and your opponents' Qbikes will spawn an endless barrier which will disappear only when the player dies.

So after a couple of minutes, the map is filled with deadly traps and dangerous walls to avoid. Watch yourself and use your abilities to avoid death.

In this mode, you will set the number of rounds to play. Round is finished when only one player is left.

The last man standing is the winner.

When you die, you teleport to the lounge zone to watch the race from the top until the new round starts.

Wishlist and Follow Qbike to keep informed about the progress. 
Early Access is coming this month!
